explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 151 lines / 10,947 characters to 104 lines / 7,542 characters: 31.1% smaller by both measures. Six peripherals expand turn admission, edit preparation, runtime ownership, event delivery, candidate execution and isolated canvas commands. Modular structure retains component boundaries and dependencies; calls and ownership explain execution and lifetimes. Data dependencies describe required inputs across these boundaries, rather than another organizational hierarchy. Trees show selected paths through those relationships; edges attach to specific concept lines. Positions use measured text bounds with gaps.

Source-grounded corrections: MCP HTTP calls enter callBoundTool directly through agentChatRoutes, not through receive as the seed's nesting implied. GenerationCanvasBridge rejects unknown IDs with the generation- prefix; remove only deletes a context, so there is no general removed-ID registry. AgentChatService.dispose marks conversations interrupted and disposes the connection; it does not call the interrupt operation or await persistence. reloadTools requires no running/starting turn, rather than strictly idle status. Fork boundary arguments are conditional on a captured turnId.

Additional details come from the pinned sources: startTurn retains accepted request IDs after failures and does not compare retry arguments; ChatDiagramTools has separate 500-entry preparation caches and enforces single-document batches; publicGeneration removes history but leaves inputHistory; generation reconciliation can recover a source through stable workspace identity; bridge receipts allow persistence retries without reapplying mutations. Sources: agentChatService.ts (turns, generations, interactions and shutdown), chatDiagramTools.ts (preparation and caches), generationCanvasBridge.ts (dispatch and receipts), codexConnection.ts and chatStore.ts (resource lifetimes), agentChatRoutes.ts (HTTP/SSE), and ports.ts (boundaries), all supplied in context.json.

Uncertainty: imported reducer, controller, MCP binding and downstream diagram-service implementations are not supplied. Their internals and end-to-end delivery guarantees are therefore not inferred. These diagrams describe the pinned implementation, not observed runtime behavior.

diagrams.ascii:
Agent Chat Lifecycle
|-- [M] Modular structure: conversation orchestration behind explicit ports
|   |-- HTTP / SSE boundary -> AgentChatService
|   |   |-- Exposes sessions, turns, canvas reads, tools, generations and events
|   |   |-- Bound tool endpoint -> token lookup + active-turn validation
|   |   `-- Public session/event projections hide toolDefinitions,
|   |       generationRequests and generation.history
|   |-- AgentChatService: public lifecycle operations; private coordination
|   |   |-- Internals: thread/session indexes, pending RPC interactions,
|   |   |   turn-start guards, generation coordination and delta buffers
|   |   |-- CodexConnection -> StdioCodexConnection -> external app-server
|   |   |-- ChatStore -> FileChatStore -> persisted session records
|   |   |-- ChatCanvasReader -> short context for a specified canvas document
|   |   |-- ChatMcpBinding -> configuration, token lookup, bind and clear
|   |   |-- ChatTools -> ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge + saved AgentContext reader
|   |       -> candidate execution and captured background evidence
|   |-- ChatDiagramTools: exposes definitions + call(name, input, session)
|   |   |-- Adapts diagram edits, views, highlights, projection and context tools
|   |   |-- Keeps target resolution, attachment reuse and retry caches internal
|   |   `-- gen-alternatives dispatch is intercepted by AgentChatService
|   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge: implements the canvas session contract
|       |-- Known generation ID -> its isolated MappingDocumentController
|       `-- Missing generation-* ID -> reject; other unknown IDs -> live port
|-- [C] Calls and callbacks: opening a conversation and running a turn
|   |-- create(settings) -> connection.request(thread/start)
|   |   `-- Save session + tool-definition snapshot -> index thread -> return
|   |-- resume(threadId)
|   |   |-- Already indexed -> get session; concurrent import -> share promise
|   |   `-- thread/resume -> reject externally active thread -> import transcript
|   |       `-- Preserve native prompt/tools; canvas tools initially disabled
|   |-- send(...) or readCanvas(...) -> startTurn(...)
|   |   |-- Known requestId -> return without issuing another turn
|   |   |-- Running / starting / reloading -> conflict
|   |   `-- Mark running -> optionally read canvas -> resume thread if needed
|   |       `-- Capture canvas + references; bind MCP target and access mode
|   |           `-- Record requestId and save session BEFORE turn/start RPC
|   |               |-- send -> text + references; readCanvas -> toolOutput
|   |               `-- Late RPC reply sets turnId only while still running
|   |-- App-server message -> receive(...) -> locate session by threadId
|   |   |-- Native tool request -> validate active turn -> dispatch cloned context
|   |   |-- Question / command approval / file approval / permission request
|   |   |   `-- Retain wire request -> emit pending interaction
|   |   |       `-- answer -> validate -> respond -> record interaction -> persist
|   |   |-- Text delta -> merge adjacent matching deltas -> buffer
|   |   |-- Item / plan / usage update -> emit corresponding session update
|   |   `-- turn/completed -> settle open items and pending interactions
|   |       |-- completed -> idle; interrupted -> interrupted; otherwise failed
|   |       `-- Persist terminal state; generation child -> finishGeneration
|   |-- MCP HTTP call -> binding + inventory + active-session checks -> dispatch
|   |-- emit -> reduceChatEvent -> retain session -> listeners -> public SSE
|   |-- interrupt(parent) -> cancel active generation children
|   |   `-- Await pending turn start -> turn/interrupt when a turn ID exists
|   `-- reloadTools, with no running/starting turn -> resume + MCP reload
|       `-- Verify inventory -> inject guidance -> save refreshed definitions
|-- [O] Responsibility for state, storage, resources and lifetimes
|   |-- AgentChatService owns conversation state and coordination
|   |   |-- Retains transcript, settings, accepted request IDs and generation data
|   |   |-- Holds transient listeners, pending wire requests and in-flight guards
|   |   |-- Startup -> load saved sessions; clear pending/activity
|   |   |   `-- In-progress items/turns become interrupted; active generations fail
|   |   |-- Connection loss -> clear resume state, requests and MCP bindings
|   |   |   `-- Flush deltas; settle interactions; fail active sessions; persist
|   |   `-- dispose -> mark active chats interrupted, fail generations, persist
|   |       `-- Flush deltas -> clear bindings -> unsubscribe -> dispose connection
|   |-- StdioCodexConnection owns child process and outstanding RPCs
|   |   |-- Shared startup -> spawn app-server -> initialize
|   |   |-- Pending RPC -> response or 30-second timeout
|   |   `-- Process/input failure -> reject pending RPCs and notify subscribers
|   |-- FileChatStore owns serialized disk writes
|   |   `-- Capture session JSON -> queued write to .tmp with mode 0600
|   |       `-- Rename to session file; failed write does not poison later queue
|   |-- ChatDiagramTools owns process-local retry and edit-run associations
|   |   |-- Session + request ID -> validated preparation; conflicts reject
|   |   `-- Canvas -> attachment; edit-run ID -> owning conversation
|   |-- Each SSE connection owns a listener and heartbeat timer
|   |   `-- Response close -> clear 15-second heartbeat and unsubscribe
|   `-- Each generation candidate owns an isolated execution lifetime
|       |-- Validate access, tools, source and prior user item; no nested generation
|       |-- Save queued children + request receipt -> capture history -> launch
|       |-- Saved context -> new thread; otherwise fork parent at turn boundary
|       |-- Clear inherited goal -> isolated controller + MCP binding -> one turn
|       |-- Bridge serializes commands, caches receipts and persists history
|       `-- Settle child -> save result -> sync source view -> release execution
`-- [D] Data dependency: what results require, across the organization above
    |-- Turn input depends on captured data [T]
    |   |-- User text + selected reference snapshots, OR short canvas tool output
    |   `-- Canvas target + reference list are cloned into the session at turn start
    |       `-- Tool execution uses [T], independent of later browser selection
    |-- Prepared diagram edit depends on
    |   |-- Tool arguments + [T] -> target document, diagram and selected nodes
    |   |-- Current snapshot -> document version + diagram revision + structure
    |   |   `-- Stale reference/revision or incomplete subtree -> reject
    |   `-- Resolved attachment + validated operations + expected version
    |       `-- submitDirect -> edit-run result owned by this conversation
    |-- Candidate result depends on shared captured history [H]
    |   |-- Source start/replay -> inputHistory -> separate controller contexts
    |   |-- Shared task + candidate prompt + model/effort/tool definitions
    |   |-- Saved AgentContext snapshot OR fork + trigger + source references
    |   `-- [H] + candidate mutations -> exported result history
    |       `-- Saved child record -> finished candidate view, including retry path
    |-- Visible transcript depends on prior session + ordered received updates
    |   `-- reduceChatEvent -> current session -> redacted snapshot/event stream
    `-- Candidate usage -> totals minus retained baseline, clamped to zero

Turn admission and tool routing [C/O/D]
|-- startTurn(id, data)
|   |-- Existing requestId -> return; arguments are not compared
|   |-- Running, starting or reloading -> conflict
|   |-- Mark running -> optional canvas read -> optional resume
|   |-- Clone canvas + references; bind eligible chat to MCP
|   |-- Append requestId -> await store.save -> turn/start
|   |   `-- Failure clears binding and marks failed
|   |       `-- Accepted requestId is not rolled back
|   `-- Reply writes turnId only if status remains running
|-- Native item/tool/call -> callTool
|   |-- Require tools, canvasTools, known name and no namespace
|   |-- Require running; check turnId when session has one
|   `-- Clone settings/context -> dispatch -> respond(wireId)
|-- HTTP tools/:name -> callBoundTool
|   |-- callId: nonempty string, at most 200 characters
|   |-- Binding token -> chat; require running + canvasTools
|   |-- Reject during reload; require name in tool inventory
|   `-- Clone settings/context -> dispatch -> HTTP result
|-- dispatchTool
|   |-- gen-alternatives -> service.genAlternatives
|   `-- Other name -> ChatTools.call
`-- Pending interaction -> answer
    |-- Require pending entry AND retained wire request
    |-- Input: every question needs a nonempty answer array
    |-- Permissions: accept non-null grants or deny with {}
    |   `-- Response scope is turn
    `-- Respond -> remove pending -> record -> persist
        `-- Secret answers are masked in interaction text

Diagram preparation and retries [M/C/O/D]
|-- ChatDiagramTools exposes definitions + call
|   `-- Private caches retain preparations, attachments and run owners
|-- edit/create/extend -> reject read-only -> parse strict schema
|   |-- Batch contains 1..20 operations
|   |-- Each target: reference XOR nodeId
|   |-- Reference canvas wins over captured turn canvas
|   |   `-- Every operation must target one canvas document
|   |-- Reuse attachment -> resolve aliases -> obtain one snapshot
|   |-- Require matching base revision and reference diagram ID
|   |-- Node selection -> roots -> full descendant membership
|   |   `-- Incomplete subtree selection rejects before submission
|   `-- Prepared operations + expectedVersion + new backend requestId
|       `-- submitDirect -> retain runId -> owning chat
|-- Retry identity: chat ID + caller requestId
|   |-- Signature covers tool name and parsed edit input
|   |-- Same signature -> reuse prepared input, submitDirect again
|   |-- Changed signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   `-- Preparation rejection evicts cache entry
|-- Projection retry identity: chat ID + transport toolCallId
|   `-- Missing toolCallId -> random ID; prepared payload is reused
|-- Edit, highlight, context, view and projection request caches
|   `-- Each rejects new entries at 500; no eviction on success shown
|-- Attachment cache: canvas target -> attachment promise
|   `-- Failure removes entry; successful attachment is reused
`-- Edit status/cancel -> require run owner == current chat
    `-- Restart loses ownership map; prior runs are rejected

Transport and durable state [C/O]
|-- StdioCodexConnection.request
|   |-- Require AI enabled -> share startup promise
|   |-- Spawn app-server with stdio pipes and configured cwd
|   |-- initialize -> initialized notification -> requested RPC
|   `-- Drain stderr; do not forward it to the browser
|-- RPC ID -> pending promise + 30-second timer
|   |-- Numeric response ID -> clear timer -> resolve/reject
|   |-- Timeout -> remove pending entry -> reject caller
|   |   `-- No cancellation message is sent by timeout handler
|   `-- Invalid JSON stdout lines are ignored
|-- Child error/exit or stdin error
|   `-- Clear child/startup -> reject pending -> notify subscribers
|-- dispose -> child.kill()
|   `-- Exit handler later resets startup; no disposed flag
|-- FileChatStore
|   |-- list: read matching JSON files under root/agent-chat
|   `-- save: stringify now -> shared write queue
|       |-- Write .tmp with mode 0600 -> rename to session file
|       `-- Caller sees failure; queue catches it for later saves
`-- AgentChatService startup and shutdown
    |-- Load: clear pending/activity; interrupt in-progress state
    |-- Running generation metadata becomes failed
    |-- Startup saves normalized records only for migration/generation
    `-- dispose marks state, invokes persist, then kills connection
        `-- persist is asynchronous; dispose does not await disk writes

Event reduction and HTTP delivery [C/O/D]
|-- Text delta -> queueDelta
|   |-- Adjacent same item ID + kind -> concatenate text
|   |-- 32 ms timer -> flush batch
|   |-- Burst check uses last/event text length > 64,000
|   `-- get() or non-delta receive also flushes
|-- emit -> reduceChatEvent -> retained session -> listeners
|-- subscribe -> initial snapshot -> live events
|   |-- Public session removes toolDefinitions + generationRequests
|   |-- publicGeneration removes history only
|   |   `-- inputHistory remains in the returned generation object
|   |-- Generation state patches filtered; batches recurse
|   `-- Tool text/diff > 1000 chars -> preview, unless in progress
|       |-- Text: last 3 lines, each at most 240 characters
|       |-- Diffs: first 3 lines, each at most 240 characters
|       `-- In-progress tools stay full; item endpoint returns details
|-- Multi-item snapshot -> empty partial snapshot + one item per part
|   `-- Last part has final=true
|-- SSE uses identity encoding and disables buffering/cache
|   |-- Backpressure: allow snapshot bytes plus 2 MiB live backlog
|   |   `-- Above allowance -> destroy stream; drain resets allowance
|   `-- Close -> clear 15-second heartbeat -> unsubscribe listener
`-- serverRequest/resolved notification
    `-- Match pending by wire ID -> remove -> record resolved item

Candidate execution and reconciliation [C/O/D]
|-- genAlternatives -> durable parent receipt + queued child records
|   |-- Same requestId + signature -> return prior receipt
|   |-- Changed signature -> conflict; prior error is rethrown
|   `-- Source start captures history; each child retains inputHistory
|-- launchGeneration
|   |-- Saved context -> thread/start + inject resolvedSnapshot/snapshot
|   |-- Otherwise -> thread/fork
|   |   |-- Parent running with turnId -> beforeTurnId
|   |   |-- Other captured turnId -> lastTurnId
|   |   `-- No turnId -> neither boundary argument is supplied
|   |-- Save thread mapping -> clear inherited goal
|   |-- Bridge.add(generation-<chatId>) -> separate controller context
|   `-- Sync generating metadata -> start one bound turn
|-- finishGeneration shares in-flight settlement
|   |-- Cancelled metadata or interrupted chat -> cancelled
|   |-- Idle chat -> finished; other state -> failed
|   |-- Export controller history OR use retained child history
|   |-- Save terminal child -> sync source candidate view
|   |   `-- Include result history only when finished
|   |-- Sync failure -> retain result and report pending save
|   `-- Finally clear binding, remove controller, unsubscribe thread
|-- Source recovery and retry
|   |-- Missing source instance + stableWorkspaceId
|   |   `-- Sync requires exactly one matching workspace/document
|   |-- generations(source) retries unsynced terminal children
|   `-- rerunAlternatives reuses run input history and child settings
|       `-- Uses same child executor; source canvas must be available
|-- Token accounting for running candidate and matching turn
|   |-- Require numeric last usage for all five counters
|   |-- First baseline = max(0, total - last), per counter
|   `-- Candidate usage = max(0, total - retained baseline)
`-- Child chats remain reviewable; send/readCanvas reject iteration
    `-- createBackground is separate: hidden from list, no canvas tools

Isolated canvas command boundary [M/C/O/D]
|-- add(id, history, persist)
|   `-- documentId = id; controller gets fresh history contextId
|-- dispatch(canvasId, command)
|   |-- Known ID -> require matching documentId
|   |-- Unknown generation-* ID -> reject
|   `-- Other unknown ID -> live.dispatch
|-- Per-candidate queue serializes reads and mutations
|   |-- Reads: identity, context, document-state, read, snapshot
|   |   `-- Snapshot can include requested/current revisions
|   `-- Remaining commands require payload.requestId
|       |-- Receipt key = method + requestId
|       |-- Signature = full serialized command
|       |-- Changed command under same key -> conflict
|       `-- New command -> apply -> cache receipt -> persist history
|           `-- Identical retry persists again without reapplying
|-- Supported mutation paths
|   |-- apply, diagram batch/revision, create, diagram context
|   |-- Batch/revision returns unresolvedEdgeIds after anchor checks
|   |-- canvas-view list -> empty saved map; save -> acknowledgement
|   |   `-- Other view operations reject; parent manages forks
|   `-- checkpoint -> check expectedVersion -> current canvasRevisionId
`-- remove deletes context; no tombstone registry is retained
    `-- dispose clears all contexts and disposes the live port

edges.label: Turn admission, transport paths and pending answers
Captured targets become validated edit input
Reduced updates become public snapshots and SSE
Captured history seeds one controller per child
